title: Sign Repair & Maintenance in Orlando
description: Business sign repair, LED and lighting service, cleaning, repainting and refresh for signs of every size in Orlando and Central Florida.

title: Sign Repair,
*Maintenance*
& Refresh
sections.text: Lights out, faded faces or storm damage? We repair, clean, repaint and upgrade business signs of every size, from storefront letters to tall pylon signs.

photos.alt: Sign with lights out before repair

cards.title: Service Calls & Repair
cards.text: Repair for channel letters, cabinets, pylon and pole signs. Storm damage repair.

cards.title: Lighting & LED Service
cards.text: LED repair, power supply replacement, LED upgrades and neon-to-LED conversion.

cards.title: Face Restoration & Cleaning
cards.text: Florida sun and rain leave faces dull. We clean letters, faces and cabinets.

cards.title: Structural Repainting
cards.text: Pylon, pole and monument painting, cabinet repainting and rust treatment.

cards.title: Refurbish & Rebuild
cards.text: Face replacement, cabinet repair and complete sign rebuilds.

cards.title: Design & Rebranding
cards.text: A new look for an existing sign: redesign, new faces and updated branding.

items.label: One visit
items.title: Sign Refresh Package
items.text: Face and letter cleaning, LED upgrades, lighting repair and repainting in one visit. Every sign is different, so we quote after a quick survey — the more you bundle, the more you save.

items.label: Several locations
items.title: Sign Maintenance Program
items.text: Scheduled inspections, cleaning and lighting checks for all your locations, so every sign stays bright and safe.

sections.title: Sign Not Looking *Its Best*?
sections.text: Send a photo of your sign and the address. We'll tell you what it needs and send a quote.
